filetandem.excludedExtensions.descriptio: Exclude file extensions from uploads, downloads, folder comparison and automatic synchronization, e.g. .log or .tar.gz. Case-insensitive. .bak backups are always excluded.
filetandem.excludedNames.description: Exclude file or folder names and their descendants. Use * and ? for name patterns, e.g. .env* or node_modules; paths are not supported. Excluded remote entries are preserved during automatic synchronization. Files remain visible in the file manager.
filetandem.excludeHidden.description: Exclude all dotfiles and dotfolders from transfers and automatic synchronization. This is independent of the Show Hidden Files display setting.
filetandem.backupRemoteDeletes.descripti: Back up remote deletions by renaming to .bak (numbered if occupied). Manual folder deletion renames the whole folder; automatic synchronization retains folders containing backups or excluded entries. WARNING: Backups beside website files may be publicly downloadable; block access on the web server. Disable to permanently delete. Local deletions still use Trash.
filetandem.sftpUploadVerification.descri: Optional additional content verification for manually started SFTP uploads. By default, checks the uploaded size without reading the server content back. Applies to newly started files. Resumed uploads, automatic monitoring and reviewed editor uploads always use full SHA-256 verification.
filetandem.sftpUploadVerification.sha256: Full SHA-256 verification: read the uploaded temporary file back and compare its content.
filetandem.sftpUploadVerification.size: Fast: verify SSH transport, source consistency and uploaded size, then publish safely. Does not read back or verify the stored remote content by checksum.
